messages:
alex_procurement: Heads up — vendor just updated ETA for the 100 H100 allocation. Partial RMA batch stuck in FRA customs, might impact our topoff plan. Jon, any details from the vendor side?

maya_ops: saw that, noticed AWB ended up on hold. We have 20 units in the inbound RMA that could cover immediate need but serials are unverified.

jon_vendor_rep: Sorry — carrier flagged HS code mismatch. We've resubmitted docs. ETA to clear is 48–72h. For the 100 units, we're prioritizing replacement AWBs for 30 units to unblock you.

tia_logistics: can you share the replacement AWBs? need to route through AMS depot. Also is there an extra brokerage fee?

jon_vendor_rep: attaching AWB numbers:
```
AWB: 9876543210
AWB: 9876543211
```
Brokerage: vendor covering first $200 per AWB, balance to be invoiced if >$200. We'll escalate customs to get faster clearance.

sam_eng_infra: If we can get 30 units in AMS within 3 business days we can cut the canary test to 24->16 instances. What are the thermal/status conditions on the returns? Any refurb/DOA rate?

jon_vendor_rep: estimated DOA/refurb rate on these RMAs ~3%. We'll stage a 10% buffer. Sending serial list tonight.

maya_ops: note: depot wants serial manifest in CSV with columns `serial,sku,condition`. Sample:
```
serial,sku,condition
ABC123,H100,new
```

alex_procurement: Budget check — vendor paying brokerage up to $200/AWB but wants 60/40 split for expedited handling beyond that. Ops, can we absorb 40% on the books for this quarter?

maya_ops: we can absorb up to $5k but need PO amendment. Finance sign-off required.

tia_logistics: re: routing — prefer AMS->FRA crossdock to avoid air uplift. ETA impact +1 day but lower cost.

jon_vendor_rep: noted. Also propose consolidated RMA AWB for leftover 70 units once FRA clears to avoid multiple brokerage fees.

sam_eng_infra: if there's a longer delay we might need to spin up on-prem spare pool in us-west. What's the expected lead time if vendor diverts some units from APAC stock?

jon_vendor_rep: divert from APAC adds 7–10 days plus customs. From EU stock it's 2–3 days once cleared.

rma_bot: [system] RMA batch 4532 status changed: "customs_hold" -> "docs_resubmitted" by jon_vendor_rep at 1717701350

alex_procurement: OK let's accept 30 expedited -> AMS crossdock, vendor covers up to $200 brokerage. Maya, please raise PO amendment and include 40% contingency if costs > $200/AWB. Sam, prep on-prem option if final ETA > 7 days.

maya_ops: raising PO now. tagging @finance for sign-off. :white_check_mark:

finance: @maya_ops received PO amendment request, will respond within 4 hours.

tia_logistics: I'll confirm pickup window with carrier after AWB issue cleared.

jon_vendor_rep: will push customs escalation and confirm new AWBs before EOD. Apologies for the churn.

alex_procurement: thanks all. keep updates in this thread. :pray:
